reason: The README describes an integration that lets a DeepSeek Harness agent and browser panel control a real DG-LAB Coyote e-stim device, including optional event-driven actuation; human review is appropriate because it affects a physical device and a person’s body.

summaries.zh: 通过官方应用和V3协议，为DeepSeek Harness智能体及浏览器面板提供DG-LAB Coyote设备配对、强度、波形和停止控制。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness agents and a browser panel to a DG-LAB Coyote device for pairing, strength, waveform, and stop controls through the official app and V3 protocol.

capabilities: Controls a DG-LAB Coyote e-stim device through the official app and V3 socket protocol
Provides agent tools and a browser panel for pairing, strength adjustment, waveform playback, stopping, and emergency shutdown
Can optionally trigger bounded device pulses from agent events
Communicates over a WebSocket server and persists imported waveform definitions
